elements.name: Data Science (Queen cell): My journey began with the chaos of my parents’ business spreadsheets during COVID-19—from the family responsibility of cleaning up messy Excel rows to a rigorous pursuit of algorithms, data science, and quantitative research.

elements.name: Our team developed an enterprise strategic solution for fintech firm BRAVO, gaining deep insights into Management Information Systems (MIS) and automated workflow streamlining.

elements.name: Identifying that traditional 60/40 equity-bond portfolios failed post-2022, our team decided to propose an automated robo-advisor API and an AI-driven early warning system utilizing R language to calculate real-time portfolio rebalancing thresholds for investors. We demonstrated our project in Seoul National University of Education, Seoul

Identifying that traditional 60/40 equity-bond portfolios failed post-2022, our team decided to propose an automated robo-advisor API and an AI-driven early warning system utilizing R language to calculate real-time portfolio rebalancing thresholds for investors.
We demonstrated our project in Seoul National University of Education, Seoul

elements.name: In this activity, our 2-member team decided to build interactive dashboards to surface consumption trends on Tableau and Excel. To deliver our insights and recommendations, we designed a presentation in Canva.
